/**
   * Notification manager for the front-end to interact with. Immediately
   * initialized, so event listeners can be added before the rest of the module
   * is initialized.
   *
   * @type {NotificationManager}
   */
  notificationManager: new NotificationManager(),

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Every new non-null manager candidate adds to its in-memory history, including website-opening types without notification UI. Visible candidates emit an event and record shown telemetry; non-UI candidates execute the call to action. This selection history is per manager and is not the persisted interactedWith list. Do not equate every counted candidate with a rendered window or a permanent daily limit across restarts. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Separate notification selection from visible presentation and persistence
